## What changed

Explain the user-visible behaviour and the case-file records affected.

## Why

Link the issue or evidence motivating this change.

## Golden-rule check

- [ ] The original idea record remains immutable.
- [ ] Generated interpretations require explicit user acceptance.
- [ ] Candidate sources are not silently promoted to truth.
- [ ] Evidence-backed labels point to stored evidence.
- [ ] The change exposes uncertainty rather than hiding it.
- [ ] Mobile operation was checked at 320 CSS pixels.
- [ ] No secret, runtime state, or uploaded paper is committed.

## Verification

- [ ] `bash scripts/check.sh`
- [ ] Manual browser test completed
- [ ] New behaviour has a regression check where practical

## Screenshots or output

Add mobile screenshots or relevant test output for UI changes.
